程序包 TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.model

类 Application

java.lang.Object
TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.model.Application
public class Application extends Object
Represents a TA job application submitted by a Teaching Assistant.

This entity tracks each application from submission through the review process. Applications are created by TAs through TAJobService.applyForJob(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) and reviewed by MOs through MOReviewService.

Application status workflow:

  1. ApplicationStatus.PENDING - Initial state after TA submits application
  2. ApplicationStatus.SHORTLISTED - MO has selected the applicant for further review
  3. ApplicationStatus.INTERVIEWED - Interview has been conducted
  4. ApplicationStatus.OFFERED - Job offer has been extended
  5. ApplicationStatus.HIRED - TA has accepted the offer and is hired
  6. ApplicationStatus.REJECTED - Application was rejected at any stage
